header: When the counter and phones are staffed
text: These are the opening hours of the Rebhanggasse office. The breakdown line, 0800 24 24 90, also answers outside them, every day of the year.
note: Closed on 24 and 31 December. Between Christmas and Epiphany, the counter opens only on 27 and 30 December, from 08:00 to 12:00. We announce holiday changes here two weeks in advance.

rows.text: Counter closes at noon; deliveries until 11:00
